Tooltip_craft_slidingGateDesc:
A chain-link gate that slides along the fence on a rail.
Built from pipes and wire; wheels and rollers are improvised from scrap metal and screws.
Tooltip_SG_GateDrive:
Install on an existing sliding gate.
Place one car battery in the drive compartment. Grid power charges it.
Tooltip_SG_DriveMount:
Electrical 1, Mechanics 1. Requires a screwdriver and wrench.
Installation: drive and 4 screws or nuts and bolts.
Mounting fasteners are not returned on removal.
Tooltip_SG_Drive_missing: The gate or its parts are not loaded.
Tooltip_SG_Drive_instance: The gate was replaced. Reopen the menu.
Tooltip_SG_Drive_busy: Wait for the gate to stop moving.
Tooltip_SG_Drive_changed: The drive was already installed or removed. Reopen the menu.
Tooltip_SG_Drive_distance: Stand near the drive post on the same floor.
Tooltip_SG_Drive_tools: Requires an unbroken screwdriver and wrench.
Tooltip_SG_Drive_materials: Requires a drive and 4 screws or nuts and bolts.
Tooltip_SG_Drive_contents: Empty the battery compartment before removing the drive.
Tooltip_SG_Drive_power: No electricity or sufficient battery charge.
Tooltip_SG_BatteryCompartment: Place one car battery in the drive compartment. Grid power charges it.
Tooltip_SG_GateRemote: Link to a drive nearby. Controls one drive within 20 cells on the same floor; walls do not block the signal. Use from inventory or the configurable hotkey.
Tooltip_SG_RemoteUnavailable: No matching carried remote or gate within range.
